text:
Ana: Quick design review — small iteration for the playground chat stream. dropping screenshots in thread. TL;DR: trying a compact stop/pause affordance + token popover instead of always-on meter. thoughts?
Kevin: saw the screenshots, looks cleaner. how does pause vs stop differ in UX here?
Ana: pause = stop streaming more tokens but keep current partial response visible and allow resume. stop = cancel generation and keep final partial result + regenerate button.
Sahil: curious about state complexity. resume needs to replay from cached KV or we re-run model? latency implications.
Maria: for hosted flow we should prefer resume-from-cache where possible. but we need clear copy so users know whether resuming will continue the same generation.
Ana: agree. proposed microcopy for hover tooltip on the pause icon: "Pause streaming — keep partial result and resume generation". open to wording.
Kevin: copy tweak: "Pause streaming" is fine, but for screen readers include context: "Pause streaming response (keeps partial text)"
DesignBot: accessibility check: add aria-label and role for the pause control. recommend: ```aria-label=\"Pause streaming response (keeps partial text)\" role=\"button\"```
Ana: thanks — will add. another part: token counter. instead of always visible token-meter, I mocked a compact token badge that expands into a popover with per-part breakdown (prompt, response, cached). hover or click to expand.
Kevin: prefer click-to-expand for mobile. hover only for desktop. the badge should show a short summary: e.g., "42 tokens" then popover shows breakdown.
Maria: can we include a subtle warning if token cost > configured budget? like a yellow dot on badge with tooltip "estimated cost above budget".
Sahil: backend note: we need to compute per-request estimate early. should be fine if we reuse sampler/tokenizer on the client or metadata from server. watch out for double counting when KV cache used.
Ana: on prompt library integration — right now we show prompt-shelf icon in the composer. proposal: long-press or small chevron to open quick prompt drawer; also allow drag-and-drop prompt snippets into the composer.
Kevin: drag-and-drop is great for power users, but need fallback keyboard action. maybe hotkey "\u2318K" / "Ctrl+K" to open prompt quickfind.
Maria: keyboard accessibility: ensure prompt snippets are reachable via arrow keys in drawer and have descriptive labels. Avoid just "snippet 1".
Sahil: implementation question: when dropping a snippet, do we replace composer text or append? Might be surprising. propose a modal option on drop for insert/replace.
Ana: good call — default append, but show small ephemeral toast: "Prompt appended — Undo / Replace" with actions.
Kevin: visual motion for streaming: currently we animate new tokens with a fade-in. suggestion: reduce motion duration for high-rate streams to keep latency feel snappy. also add a subtle shimmer only on first token to show it's generating.
DesignBot: accessibility nits: ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion: reduce shimmer, keep functional changes only. also maintain contrast ratio for token badge text (min 4.5:1).
Maria: microcopy for regenerate/stop: current labels sometimes confuse users. propose: primary action = "Regenerate" when there is a final result; secondary destructive = "Stop generation" while streaming. When paused show "Resume" not "Continue".
Ana: love that. small UX detail: place regenerate next to the message overflow menu rather than inline to avoid accidental taps.
Sahil: also add rate-limiter feedback. if user hits regen too fast, show inline friendly toast: "Still warming up — try again in 3s" rather than a modal.
Kevin: one more: onboarding hint for token popover the first time a workspace uses it: a subtle pulsing highlight around the token badge with copy "See estimated token usage" and a "Don't show again" checkbox.
Maria: ensure we persist that setting per-user, not per-workspace. some teams will want repeated reminders for new hires.
Ana: I'll update mocks with the accessibility label changes, the compact badge popover, and the pause vs stop microcopy. pushing an updated Figma by EOD. please flag any hard blockers here.
Kevin: no blockers from design side.
Sahil: dev ok, just need API for token breakdown and resume-from-cache flags. will open a PR for the server bits.
Maria: QA: I'll write test cases for keyboard flows, ARIA labels, toast behavior, and token-warning states.
Ana: thanks all :rocket: — will ping again when figma and specs landed.
DesignBot: Note: thread archived in 7 days unless pinned.
